title: Codings of 13 trustworthy-AI frameworks, with a crosswalk to a seven-step practitioner's loop
description: 108 headline items from 13 trustworthy-AI frameworks (7 public, 6 company), coded against 19 themes and mapped to a seven-step practitioner's loop. First coding by Claude (Anthropic), blind second coding by Gemini (Google), disagreements settled by the author. Labels and codes only; no framework text.
